ui_bugs.issue: BottomNav passed `key="home"` / `key="reels"` etc. as a prop to <SideItem>; React filters out `key` (it's a reserved prop), so the destructure `{ key: k }` was always undefined, producing data-testid="nav-undefined" for ALL side items. Fixed in this iteration by renaming the prop to `navKey`. After fix all 4 side testids resolve.

issues: FAB is centered at x=195 on a 390-wide viewport (correct), bottom-8px (above pill at bottom-3). 'Made with Emergent' badge at bottom-right still overlaps the pill's right edge slightly on tiny viewports — known preview-host overlay only, no app fix needed.

action_items: VERIFIED FIX (already applied by testing agent): Renamed `key` prop to `navKey` in /app/frontend/src/components/layout/BottomNav.js so SideItem testids actually render. Main agent should keep this fix.

(Note for main agent) Listing-detail route is `/listing/:id` (singular) in App.js but the review request listed `/listings/{id}`. UI links use the correct singular form — no action needed, just a docs sync.
critical_code_review_comments: BottomNav.js: previously used `key` as both a React reserved prop AND a destructured value — React strips `key` so child never received it. Standard footgun; fix is to use any other name (navKey).

BottomNav FAB markup is solid — uses absolute pulse rings (.animate-ping + .animate-pulse), conic-gradient rotating border via inline style, baby-blue gradient (#4FB6E6 → #3AA9DD), correct fixed bottom-8 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-[51] which sits above the pill at bottom-3 z-50. Visually a clean floating hologram.

ImageViewer.js: pinch + double-tap + drag logic is well-isolated via refs. setZoom uses functional updater for pinch path. Clamp [1,5] for pinch and [1,4] for buttons — minor inconsistency but acceptable.

Backend update_listing price-drop trigger correctly excludes the listing owner from notifications, computes pct as round((1 - new/old) * 100), stores typed payload, and dispatches expo push asynchronously with try/except wrapped — robust.
POST /watches uses upsert keyed on (user_id, listing_id) — idempotent, good. DELETE /watches/{listing_id} returns success even if doc didn't exist — also fine.
Follow toggle endpoint POST /sellers/{id}/follow is idempotent toggle (insert if absent, delete if present) and rejects self-follow with 400.

rca_of_the_issue: BottomNav data-testid bug RCA: The `SideItem` component was rendered with attribute `key="home"` etc. In React, `key` is a reserved special prop used by the reconciler and is NEVER forwarded to the function/class component as a regular prop — so destructuring `{ key: k }` always yields `undefined`. Symptom: React DevTools shows the SideItem component but its rendered Link gets `data-testid="nav-undefined"` for all 4 side items, breaking automated tests. Reproduction: load any page → query `[data-testid="nav-home"]` → null. Mitigation applied: rename the prop to `navKey` (or any non-reserved name like `id`, `slug`). Verified post-fix: all 4 testids resolve (`/`, `/reels`, `/chat`, `/profile`).
